name: WhatsApp Property Extraction - Reference Blueprint
purpose: Process authorized incoming WhatsApp messages into validated property records without sending outbound messages.

steps.description: Receive an authenticated incoming message event from the configured provider.
Normalize event fields while preserving meaningful text, plot identifiers, units, and phone digits.
Determine whether the message contains a relevant real-estate listing.
Extract fields supported by the source message and use null for missing values.
Validate JSON types, enums, required keys, and field consistency.
When all values are present, compare block, plot_number, and phone. Do not merge records with missing or ambiguous key values.
Write the validated record to a configured spreadsheet, CRM, or database using least-privilege credentials.
Record message ID, processing outcome, and sanitized errors without exposing secrets or unnecessary message content.

notes: This file describes workflow logic; it is not a directly importable n8n workflow.
Provider-specific payload mappings and credentials must be configured for each deployment.
Use synthetic data for development and testing.
